title: Findings
description: The result of one interrogation. Machine-produced and machine-consumed. The severity enum here is the single definition of the taxonomy: verify, remediate, land and CI all branch on it.

framework_version.description: Global constraints live in the library, so an upgrade can change the rules an artifact is judged against with no commit in the solution. Without this, a verdict is not reproducible.

artifact.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact interrogated.

round.description: Interrogations of the same artifact are numbered; each is kept, none overwritten.

severity.description: blocking stops the cycle and is worked by remediation. suggestion never blocks and is never remediated.

disposition.description: waived is derived from the cycle's waivers document, never asserted here.

constraintId.description: CON resolves in the library's constraints.md, LOC in the solution's.

statement.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.

locus.description: Where in the artifact — a quoted phrase, a heading, or a path and line. A finding with no locus cannot be acted on.

remedy.description: What would resolve it. Required for blocking: remediation cannot work a finding that does not say what would fix it.

allOf.description: A blocking finding must say what would resolve it: remediation cannot work a finding that names no remedy.
